Card Q&A.a: A yellow Option card with a cost of 5 or less or a purple Option card with a cost of 5 or less.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be placed as the bottom security card by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Card Q&A.a: A yellow Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and the [Data] trait or a yellow Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and the [Witchelny] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What cards will trigger this card's inherited effect when they would leave the battle area?

If [Wizardmon] or [X Antibody] is in digivolution cards, can I use this card’s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a yellow or purple Option card with a cost of 5 or less from my hand as the bottom security card even when I can't add my top security card to the hand?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, if [Wizardmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may place 1 use cost 5 or lower yellow or purple Option card from your hand as the bottom security card.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this yellow Digimon with the [Data] or [Witchelny] trait would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by trashing your top security card, it doesn't leave.
